data.one_liner: A CLI tool to share and synchronize versions for multiple packages in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: shared_versions matches and shares package dependency versions across multiple packages in Flutter using a shared_versions.yaml file. It can be run as a command-line tool to manage consistent dependency versions.
use_when: You need to synchronize dependency versions across multiple packages in a Flutter project.
You want to maintain a centralized version configuration file for your packages.
avoid_when: You only have a single package and do not need to share versions across multiple packages.
You prefer built-in workspace dependency management features without external CLI tools.
strengths: Simplifies version synchronization across multiple packages.
Supports custom paths for the versions configuration file.
weaknesses: Relies on an external CLI command execution.
data.setup_notes: Add shared_versions to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and create a shared_versions.yaml file in the root of the package.
data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
    shared_versions: ^1.0.0

# Run via:
flutter pub run shared_versions
